purpose: RPG Maker-style authoring packages and editor feature specs for turning RPG Zzu demos into playable RPG loops.

skills.useWhen: Need to author a complete short quest with objective, condition, reward, and closure.
Need to create NPCs with game roles instead of decorative dialogue only.
Need to author treasure chests, doors, switches, signs, healing points, traps, or locked gates.
Need rewards that change player state after quests, objects, or battles.
Need a battle that has purpose, pacing, weakness, reward, and failure handling.
Need a map layout that creates traversal, gating, landmarking, and exploration.
Need dialogue scenes with speaker intent, choice, pacing, and emotional state.
Need a complete first demo loop combining map, NPC, quest, object, battle, reward, and return.
